 Iowa Down Ballot: Trump’s Iowa stops, close US House races and early voting
 Kathie Obradovich 
 October 25, 2026 2:06 pm 
 President Donald Trump gave remarks at the Sioux Gateway Airport in Sioux City Oct. 22, 2026 for a rally supporting Iowa Republicans in the upcoming midterm elections. (Photo by Robin Opsahl/Iowa Capital Dispatch)
 Iowa Down Ballot 10/25/26 by Iowa Writers Collaborative
 Kathie Obradovich and Laura Belin are joined by Shane Vander Hart to discuss two Trump visits, three close house races, and early voting.
 Read on Substack 
 Kathie Obradovich, Laura Belin and Shane Vander Hart discuss the first of two Iowa visits by President Donald Trump and whether it matters for voter turnout. Plus, the Iowa 1st Congressional District debate , tight U.S. House races, record fundraising in the governor’s race and early voting in person versus by mail. Read or listen here .

 Kathie Obradovich

She previously covered the Iowa Statehouse for 10 years for newspapers in Davenport, Waterloo, Sioux City, Mason City and Muscatine.
